Redirect.label: Redirections (SEO)
Redirect.schema: CREATE TABLE seo_redirects (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, old_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, new_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, code INT DEFAULT 301, hits INT DEFAULT 0, last_hit DATETIME NULL, active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
